name: Mount Elbert
season_notes: Colorado's highest peak. Usually snow-free from late June to September; start early to avoid afternoon storms.

name: Mount Massive
season_notes: Long, high ridge. Best July to September; weather changes fast above treeline.

name: Mount Harvard
season_notes: Long day up Horn Fork Basin. Snow can linger into July.

name: Mount Princeton
season_notes: Steep, rocky trail above the radio towers. Best late June to September.

name: Mount of the Holy Cross
season_notes: Long day over Half Moon Pass. Best July to September.

name: Longs Peak (Keyhole Route)
season_notes: Start before dawn; afternoon storms are common. Snow and ice on the route can linger well into summer.

name: Pikes Peak
season_notes: Barr Trail is a long, steady climb. The summit is also reachable by road and cog railway; check conditions above treeline.

name: Mount Blue Sky (Mount Evans)
season_notes: A high road reaches near the summit in summer; hiking routes start from Summit Lake or Echo Lake. Weather changes quickly above treeline.

name: Mount Bierstadt
season_notes: Willow thickets near the start can be wet in early summer.

name: Grays Peak
season_notes: Often paired with neighboring Torreys Peak.

name: Torreys Peak
season_notes: Usually climbed with Grays Peak via the saddle. Loose rock near the summit.

name: James Peak
season_notes: Broad, open summit. Snow lingers into early summer.

name: Quandary Peak
season_notes: Popular beginner 14er; snow lingers into June.

name: Mount Democrat
season_notes: Often climbed as a loop with nearby 14ers. Check land-access notices before going.

name: Mount Sherman
season_notes: One of the more approachable 14ers; old mine roads lead most of the way.

name: Blanca Peak
season_notes: Long approach on a rough 4WD road. Snow can linger on the upper route.

name: Uncompahgre Peak
season_notes: Gentle trail until the final steep section. Best July to September.

name: Handies Peak
season_notes: Moderate trail with good wildflowers in July.

name: Mount Sneffels
season_notes: Steep scree and a rocky, exposed gully near the top. Snow persists into summer.

name: Mount Wilson
season_notes: Exposed ridge scrambling; not for beginners.

name: Maroon Peak
season_notes: Steep, loose rock in the Maroon Bells. Plan to be off the peak before afternoon storms.

name: Capitol Peak
season_notes: Known for the exposed Knife Edge. Best for experienced climbers in good conditions.

name: Mount Audubon
season_notes: Popular Indian Peaks climb. Wind can be severe above treeline.

name: Mount Sanitas
season_notes: Short, steep Boulder-area trail that is popular in every season. Check for ice in winter.

name: Bear Peak
season_notes: Boulder-area peak with a rocky summit. Trails can be icy in winter.
